papers.title_en: The Endgame of FSDP Communication: Layout-Aware Collectives on Copy Engines, RDMA, and NVSwitch
papers.authors: Zejian Wang, Yifan Zhao, Kaihui Ren, Xiaoling Zhou, Yubin Wang, Chenhao Guan, Lin Zhang, Yufeng Li, Zhikang Mo, Zhuoru Ma, Yingtong Xiong, Jihu Guo, Yiqiao Liao, Chengru Song
papers.evidence: 面向 FSDP2 训练的零拷贝布局感知 AllGather/ReduceScatter 集合通信并与 GEMM 重叠
papers.tldr: FSDP2 把参数和梯度按单个参数张量存储，集合通信却使用扁平、按 rank 主序排列的缓冲区，因此每次 all-gather 都要把输出拷贝进参数存储，并额外打包梯度。TIDE 基于公开 NCCL API 实现零拷贝集合通信，把布局放置折入集合寻址，TIDE-AG 用 NVSwitch 组播与 RDMA 直接投递分片，TIDE-RS 直接消费 bf16 梯度并归约为 fp32 分片。在 64 GPU 上，它把 Llama-3.1 70B 等模型的步时最多降低 27.1%，并大幅减少 SM 占用和计算干扰。
papers.abstract_en: Fully Sharded Data Parallelism (FSDP2) maintains parameters and gradients as per-parameter tensors, whereas its collective path operates on flat, rank-major buffers. Converting between these layouts copies all-gather outputs into parameter storage and packs gradients into full-group fp32 buffers. Layout conversion alone accounts for 6.4% of step time in Llama-3.1 70B training at 8K tokens per GPU. Communication kernels impose a second cost: a default NCCL reduce-scatter can slow a concurrent GEMM that would otherwise complete in a single wave by 69%. We present TIDE, a set of zero-copy collectives built on public NCCL 2.31+ APIs. TIDE preserves FSDP2's per-parameter storage and compute kernels while folding layout placement into collective addressing. TIDE-AG delivers shards directly to parameter storage using NVSwitch multicast and paced recursive-doubling RDMA, with no SMs used for transport or placement. TIDE-RS consumes per-parameter bf16 gradients directly and reduces them into fp32 shards (a mixed-precision mode that NCCL does not provide) using copy engines and short-lived thread blocks (CTAs) for node-local accumulation and NVSwitch for cross-node reduction. A two-phase pipeline separates gradient reads from network progress; Slot-Reuse optionally stages gradients in vacated all-gather slots. On 64 GPUs, TIDE reduces step time by up to 27.1% relative to Stock FSDP2 and 6.0% relative to FSDP2+SymmMem across Llama-3.1 70B, Wan2.2, and Qwen3-30B-A3B. It reduces reduce-scatter SM time by factors of 12.5-14.5 and cuts interference with concurrent compute by up to an order of magnitude. Its reduce-scatter buffer remains nearly constant from 16 to 64 GPUs at a fixed per-GPU output size, and its peak memory is up to 4.7 GiB below FSDP2+SymmMem's and, with Slot-Reuse on Wan2.2, below Stock FSDP2's.

papers.title_en: LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes
papers.authors: Jiaming Hu, Zhida Jiang, Zhaolong Xing, Yu Li, Zhen Chen, Ke Zhang
papers.evidence: 显存受限下联合专家放置与负载均衡的内存感知MoE训练系统
papers.tldr: 稀疏MoE训练中路由不均导致计算通信瓶颈，复制专家又挤占显存。LRMoE联合重校准反向需求与保留负载平衡：前向规划保留配额和专家放置，反向用负载重校准度量筛选token-expert对并容量感知路由，配合物理压缩降低通信与计算。在Qwen3-30B-A3B和GLM4.5-106B-A12B上，达到固定损失累计MoE层训练时间较SYMI降21.2-44.8%。为显存受限节点高效MoE训练提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer scalable capacity for Web applications, but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. Existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload, yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited GPU memory. We present LRMoE, a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances the retained workload. During forward execution, it plans retention quotas and expert placement under resource constraints while preserving all routed computations. During backpropagation, a load recalibration metric estimates each token-expert pair's contribution to the expert update and selects pairs within these quotas. A capacity-aware routing algorithm distributes retained pairs among eligible instances of their original experts. Physical compaction then forms smaller communication payloads and variable-size grouped GEMMs, reducing backward traffic, computation, and execution-buffer demand. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B show that LRMoE reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time to fixed-loss targets by 21.2-44.8% relative to SYMI.

papers.title_en: MCCL: Training Pytorch models across a fleet of Macs at Skywalker Sound
papers.authors: Kevin Sasso, Chris Fiegel, Francis Aitken, Nicolas Tsingos, Nicholas Tong
papers.evidence: 面向多节点训练的集合通信库并实现AllReduce
papers.tldr: 音频后期公司Skywalker Sound拥有200多台闲置M4 Max Mac Studio，但PyTorch缺少面向Apple MPS的多节点分布式后端。作者提出开源MCCL，在交换式以太网上实现多机MPS训练通信。24节点测试中all-reduce达TCP有效吞吐的98-99.7%，113.5M参数ViT扩展至4568样本/秒、并行效率95.9%。每晚利用100台闲置Mac可年省约20万美元云算力，证明现有Mac集群可复用于高性能分布式训练。
papers.abstract_en: Skywalker Sound, a premier audio post-production facility, operates more than 200 M4 Max Mac Studios on a 10Gb Ethernet network. When not in use by artists, these machines sit idle, representing massive untapped unified memory and compute capacity. While these fleets are excellent candidates for distributed machine learning alongside existing NVIDIA GPU clusters, PyTorch lacks an accelerated distributed backend for Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS). To bridge this gap, we introduce the Metal Communication Collective Library (MCCL), the first open-source MPS backend for multi-node PyTorch training over switched Ethernet. We evaluate its performance and scalability across 24 nodes, demonstrating that large all-reduce operations reach 98-99.7% of TCP goodput. Training a 113.5M-parameter Vision Transformer (ViT) scales from 198 to 4,568 samples/s, achieving 95.9% parallel efficiency. Benchmarked against an NVIDIA A100 GPU, one M4 Max Mac equals roughly 1.7x the throughput of FP32 matrix multiplication, and 5.5 Macs match an A100 using TF32. Harnessing 100 idle Macs for 12 hours nightly offsets approximately $200,000 annually in equivalent cloud compute costs. Our results demonstrate that existing Mac infrastructure can be seamlessly repurposed for high performance distributed training without abandoning the standard PyTorch codebase.

papers.title_en: Muon Makes the First Mixture-of-Experts Layer Harder to Balance
papers.evidence: 研究Muon优化器扩大路由偏置跨度、使首个MoE层更难负载均衡
papers.tldr: 许多开源MoE语言模型用Muon而非AdamW训练，但路由负载均衡偏置的跨度会反映各层均衡难度。作者在55M与108M激活参数模型上比较优化器对首个MoE层偏置跨度的影响。结果显示Muon在全部随机种子下约将首层跨度翻倍，主因是网络其余部分用Muon，且首层路由输入存在共享方向，最忙专家一度承担4–7倍公平份额。对输入减去批均值可消除过载而几乎不损损失，说明首层均衡需针对性处理。
papers.abstract_en: Many open mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models train with Muon instead of AdamW. Most balance the load with a bias on each expert's routing score, adjusted after every step. Their recipes disagree on whether Muon should also train the router. In models with 55M and 108M active parameters, we measure how the optimizer changes the span of these biases, the largest minus the smallest in a layer. The span grows when all tokens favor the same experts, so it shows how hard a layer is to balance. At learning rates tuned on shorter runs, Muon raised the span of the first MoE layer at every seed, roughly doubling it on average, while the other layers changed much less. The rise came from Muon on the rest of the network, whichever optimizer trained the router. In those runs, the inputs to the first router shared a direction, and soon after the warmup its busiest expert averaged four to seven times its fair share. Over the first 3,000 steps, subtracting the batch mean from these inputs removed this overload while barely changing the loss. On the smaller model, halving Muon's learning rate removed most of the rise and slightly improved the loss. Moving only the router to AdamW made the loads shift more during the warmup and slightly raised the loss, so at this scale the results favor keeping the router on Muon.

papers.title_en: Dobb: Shard-Local Preconditioning in Block-Diagonal Eigenbases
papers.authors: Shi-Yuk Fong, Shuhua Yu, Jiawei Zhang
papers.evidence: 分片本地优化器更新减少分布式LLM训练中的跨分片通信
papers.tldr: 大规模语言模型的参数与优化器状态常超出单节点内存，需在TP或FSDP下跨设备分片；Muon等矩阵感知优化器的全局矩阵运算会带来通信开销。Dobb以对角块近似输入激活二阶矩，在每个块内维护完整特征基，将动量投影到该基后做符号归一化并重建更新。在GPT-2 XL 1.56B上，16块Dobb取得2.476验证损失，优于Dion的2.511；在32张H100的FSDP下，优化器调用摊销时间由124.1 ms降至9.2 ms。该方法让矩阵更新在分片内局部执行，仅需激活二阶矩的数据并行同步，从而降低通信并提升扩展性。
papers.abstract_en: Training language models whose parameters and optimizer state exceed a single node's memory requires sharding these tensors across devices. Under tensor parallelism (TP) or fully sharded data parallelism (FSDP), matrix-aware optimizers such as Muon introduce communication to perform global matrix operations across shards. We propose Dobb (Distributed Optimizer with Block-diagonal Eigenbases), a matrix-aware optimizer designed to compute updates locally within parameter shards. Dobb approximates the input-activation second moment with diagonal blocks and tracks a complete basis within each block. It projects momentum into these bases, applies sign normalization to the coefficients, and reconstructs the update. When each block lies within one shard under TP or FSDP, Dobb applies its matrix update locally, requiring no communication beyond data-parallel synchronization of the activation second moments. We benchmark Dobb against Dion, a distributed matrix-aware optimizer designed to retain the benefits of orthonormalized updates while reducing communication. On GPT-2 XL (1.56B parameters), Dobb with 16 blocks reaches a validation loss of 2.476, compared with 2.511 for Dion at rank fraction 1/16. Under FSDP on 32 H100 GPUs, Dobb reduces the amortized optimizer-call time from 124.1 ms for Dion to 9.2 ms.

papers.title_en: Constant-Factor Approximation for Non-Splitting Coflow Scheduling in Heterogeneous Parallel Networks via Iterative Relaxation
papers.evidence: 异构并行网络中集合通信Coflow的调度
papers.tldr: 异构并行网络中的非分裂 coflow 调度要求每条流整体走单一核心，已有近似比会随核心数 m 或端口最大流度 τ 线性增长。本文用迭代松弛舍入同时处理输入与输出端口容量，替代易使端口负载膨胀的按最大分数值取整。对 makespan，纯 EPS、非全停 OCS、全停 OCS 分别达到 min{τ,3}、2min{τ,3}、4min{τ,3}；对加权完成时间分别达到 8min{τ,4}、16min{τ,4}、32min{τ,4}。这些绝对常数界不随 m 或 τ 增长，并证明底层 LP 整数间隙至少为 2。
papers.abstract_en: Coflows capture the collective communication requirements of data-parallel applications, and scheduling them well is essential to the performance of modern data centers. We study non-splitting coflow scheduling in a heterogeneous parallel network whose $m$ network cores may be Electronic Packet Switches (EPS), not-all-stop Optical Circuit Switches (OCS), or all-stop OCS, where every flow must be transmitted entirely through a single core. Previous approximation algorithms for this setting have guarantees that grow linearly with the number of cores $m$ or with the maximum flow degree $τ$ of a port, and therefore become weak as data centers deploy more cores. The source of this dependence is the rounding step: rounding each flow to the core holding its largest fractional value can inflate the load of a port by a factor of $m$. We replace this step with an iterative relaxation rounding scheme that handles the input-port and output-port capacity constraints simultaneously. For minimizing the makespan, this yields approximation ratios of $\min\{τ, 3\}$, $2\min\{τ, 3\}$, and $4\min\{τ, 3\}$ for pure EPS, pure not-all-stop OCS, and pure all-stop OCS networks, respectively. For minimizing the total weighted coflow completion time, we obtain approximation ratios of $8\min\{τ, 4\}$, $16\min\{τ, 4\}$, and $32\min\{τ, 4\}$ for the same three architectures. In a hybrid network, the guarantee is governed by the weakest architecture present, so the overall ratios are at most $4\min\{τ,3\}\le 12$ and $32\min\{τ,4\}\le 128$, respectively. Unlike all previous guarantees for non-splitting coflow scheduling in heterogeneous parallel networks, these bounds are absolute constants that do not grow with the number of cores $m$ or with the flow degree $τ$. We also show that the integrality gap of the underlying linear program is at least $2$.
